messages.en: Oh, did I mention this before?
I've always been interested in it,
but lately I've gotten even more into studying history.
I've been studying it really hard.
About times we never lived in...

messages.ko: 지금 이 땅에서 무슨일이 일어났었는지 궁금하지않아?
messages.en: Aren't you curious about what happened on this land back then?
Australopithecus Hayeon.
I'm not quite that far yet. ^^^
I'm also really curious about the time when my mom and dad were young.
I'm really curious,
and I find it fascinating.
It feels like *Reply 1988*.
I'm so cool right now.
I look super smart.
Heh.
But... you came in last in the Badge Wars general knowledge quiz?
That was an advanced strategy, you know.

messages.ko: 내가 뱃지를 많이 가져서 분량을 얻는건 아주 힘들겠군
messages.en: I figured it'd be really hard to get screen time just by collecting lots of badges.
So I quickly decided on a different concept.

messages.ko: 추석 자컨 게임 꼴찌는 어떻게 된건데 그럼
messages.en: Then what about coming in last in the Chuseok self-content games?
That wasn't me.
Ah, Jeong Haseok again.
Oh, it was that guy?
Seriously, what is he even doing?
